metadata.question: Was the vegetation cover near the Damietta branch of the Nile mouth greater in 1984 than in 2021?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Region: 15 km buffer around the Damietta Nile mouth near Ras El-Bar, Egypt (approx 31.82E, 31.52N).
- Years: 1984 vs 2021.
- Collections:
  * 1984: Landsat 5 L2 SR with fallback to Landsat 4 L2 SR.
  * 2021: Landsat 8 and 9 L2 SR.
2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Mask clouds, cloud shadows, snow using QA_PIXEL bits; do not mask water.
- Use per-year median NDVI composites to reduce residual clouds.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- Check image collection sizes; if zero after fallbacks, output C1.
- Count valid pixels in composite; if zero, output C2.
- Validate metrics are finite and in [0,1]; otherwise, C3.
- Compare vegetation cover (NDVI>0.3 fraction of area) between 1984 and 2021.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const yearA = 1984;
    const yearB = 2021;
    const region = ee.Geometry.Point([31.82, 31.52]).buffer(15000); // Damietta branch mouth vicinity (~15 km)

    // Helper: total region pixel count at 1km
    const scale = 1000;
    const totalCount = await ee.Image(1).rename('one')
      .reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('one').getInfo();

    if (!totalCount || totalCount === 0) {
      console.log("Region pixels (1km): 0");
      console.log("C2");
      return;
    }

    console.log(`Region pixels (1km): ${totalCount}`);

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Processing
    function getIdsForYear(y) {
      if (y <= 1999) return ['LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2', 'LANDSAT/LT04/C02/T1_L2']; // 1984 era
      if (y < 2013) return ['LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2'];
      // 2013+ era (2021 includes 8 and 9)
      return ['LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2', 'LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2'];
    }

    function maskScaleToNDVI(image) {
      const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL');
      const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0) // dilated cloud
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0))      // cirrus (if available)
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0))      // cloud
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0))      // cloud shadow
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0));     // snow
      const scaleF = ee.Image(0.0000275);
      const offset = ee.Image(-0.2);
      const sr = image.select(['SR_B4', 'SR_B5']).multiply(scaleF).add(offset).updateMask(mask);
      const ndvi = sr.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDVI');
      return ndvi.copyProperties(image, image.propertyNames());
    }

    async function analyzeYear(y) {
      const ids = getIdsForYear(y);
      let colRaw = ee.ImageCollection(ids[0])
        .filterBounds(region)
        .filterDate(`${y}-01-01`, `${y}-12-31`);
      for (let i = 1; i < ids.length; i++) {
        const extra = ee.ImageCollection(ids[i])
          .filterBounds(region)
          .filterDate(`${y}-01-01`, `${y}-12-31`);
        colRaw = colRaw.merge(extra);
      }

      // Check for empty collection; try widening window slightly as a last resort
      let size = await colRaw.size().getInfo();
      if (size === 0) {
        // widen by +/- 6 months
        const start = ee.Date.fromYMD(y, 1, 1).advance(-6, 'month');
        const end = ee.Date.fromYMD(y, 12, 31).advance(6, 'month');
        let widened = ee.ImageCollection(ids[0]).filterBounds(region).filterDate(start, end);
        for (let i = 1; i < ids.length; i++) {
          widened = widened.merge(ee.ImageCollection(ids[i]).filterBounds(region).filterDate(start, end));
        }
        const widenedSize = await widened.size().getInfo();
        if (widenedSize > 0) {
          colRaw = widened;
          size = widenedSize;
        }
      }
      if (size === 0) {
        return { status: 'C1' };
      }

      const cloudAvg = await ee.Number(colRaw.aggregate_mean('CLOUD_COVER')).getInfo();

      const ndviCol = colRaw.map(maskScaleToNDVI);
      const ndviMed = ndviCol.median();

      const validCount = await ndviMed.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('NDVI').getInfo();

      if (!validCount || validCount === 0) {
        return { status: 'C2', size, cloudAvg };
      }

      const vegCount = await ndviMed.gt(0.3).rename('veg').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('veg').getInfo();

      const validFrac = validCount / totalCount;
      const vegFrac = vegCount / totalCount;

      if (!isFinite(validFrac) || !isFinite(vegFrac) || vegFrac < 0 || vegFrac > 1) {
        return { status: 'C3', size, cloudAvg, validCount, vegCount };
      }

      return {
        status: 'OK',
        size,
        cloudAvg,
        validCount,
        vegCount,
        validFrac,
        vegFrac
      };
    }

    const resA = await analyzeYear(yearA);
    if (resA.status !== 'OK') {
      if (resA.status === 'C1') {
        console.log(`${yearA} Images: 0`);
        console.log("C1");
        return;
      }
      if (resA.status === 'C2') {
        console.log(`${yearA} Images: ${resA.size || 0}, Avg CLOUD_COVER: ${resA.cloudAvg != null ? resA.cloudAvg.toFixed(1) : 'NA'}%`);
        console.log("C2");
        return;
      }
      console.log("C3");
      return;
    }
    console.log(`${yearA} Images: ${resA.size}, Avg CLOUD_COVER: ${resA.cloudAvg != null ? resA.cloudAvg.toFixed(1) : 'NA'}%`);
    console.log(`${yearA} Valid%: ${(resA.validFrac*100).toFixed(1)}%, Veg%: ${(resA.vegFrac*100).toFixed(1)}%`);

    const resB = await analyzeYear(yearB);
    if (resB.status !== 'OK') {
      if (resB.status === 'C1') {
        console.log(`${yearB} Images: 0`);
        console.log("C1");
        return;
      }
      if (resB.status === 'C2') {
        console.log(`${yearB} Images: ${resB.size || 0}, Avg CLOUD_COVER: ${resB.cloudAvg != null ? resB.cloudAvg.toFixed(1) : 'NA'}%`);
        console.log("C2");
        return;
      }
      console.log("C3");
      return;
    }
    console.log(`${yearB} Images: ${resB.size}, Avg CLOUD_COVER: ${resB.cloudAvg != null ? resB.cloudAvg.toFixed(1) : 'NA'}%`);
    console.log(`${yearB} Valid%: ${(resB.validFrac*100).toFixed(1)}%, Veg%: ${(resB.vegFrac*100).toFixed(1)}%`);

    const diff = resA.vegFrac - resB.vegFrac;
    console.log(`Veg% Diff (${yearA}-${yearB}): ${(diff*100).toFixed(1)}%`);

    // Final Answer
    // A: Yes (1984 > 2021), B: No
    console.log(diff > 0 ? "A" : "B");
  } catch (err) {
    console.log("D");
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
